transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

I'm visiting today because I've been struggling with severe sleep issues and constant, uncontrollable worry for over two years now. It has been going on for so long, and I've really been finding it hard to get any rest.
When you feel worried, do you also get symptoms like restlessness, muscle tension, fatigue, trouble concentrating, or irritability?

I don't really experience those physical symptoms like muscle tension, and I wouldn't say I get particularly irritable when I'm anxious. For me, it is much more about my mind constantly racing with worries that I just can't seem to shut off.
Do you worry about many different areas of your life, such as work, finances, health, or family, most days?

Yes, absolutely. My worries aren't just about one thing; they seem to spread to almost every area of my life, including my job, our finances, and my family. I feel this way almost every single day, and it feels like there is always something to worry about.
Has this worry made it hard for you to work, manage daily tasks, or enjoy your life?
I'm not entirely sure, and I haven't really thought about it in those terms before. But I do know that the constant worrying makes it quite hard to focus on my tasks during the day.
You mentioned this has been going on for over two years—has the worry been present more days than not during that whole time?
Yes, absolutely. For the entire two years and three months, the worry has been there almost every single day. It really feels like a constant background presence that I just can't escape.
Have you had this anxiety and worry for at least 6 months, with difficulty controlling it and symptoms like sleep problems or trouble concentrating?

Yes, it has been much longer than six months—about two years and three months now, and I find it incredibly difficult to control or stop the worrying once it starts. It completely ruins my sleep by making it hard to fall asleep and waking me up throughout the night, and the constant intrusive thoughts make it really difficult to concentrate during the day.
